name: MVDream Multi-View Diffusion Guidance
definition: Provides gradient guidance for 3D optimization by encoding RGB images and camera poses into a multi-view diffusion model, predicting noise, and stepping the DDIM scheduler.
summary: MVDream is a guidance method that fine-tunes Stable Diffusion with 3D-aware components to improve multi-view consistency and alleviate the Janus problem in text-to-3D generation.
